summary: Forms need a little CSS to be readable: labels on their own lines, fields a consistent width, and a clear submit button.
notes: font: inherit makes inputs and buttons use the page font. By default they use a smaller system font.
input[type="text"] is an attribute selector. It matches only inputs whose type is text.
display: block on label stacks each label above its field.
pitfall: Setting a border: none on inputs to look clean. People can no longer see where to type.
